page_title: ATM 0-3 BAR | Atletico Madrid v Barcelona 17/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) takes a shot from the free kick on the edge of the box and the ball sails inches wide of the right post. What a chance!
90+2' The game is interrupted by the referee. He pulls out a red card and sends Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) off.
90+1' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box. His effort heads for the left side of the goal, but Jan Oblak denies him.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
90' Koke (Atl. Madrid) jumps into a tackle and Jose Sanchez signals a foul. Barcelona win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
89' The game is interrupted. Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
88' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
86' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the right post.
84' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
82' Xavi has decided to substitute Fermin Lopez and he is replaced by Inigo Martinez (Barcelona).
82' The substitution has been made. Marc Casado (Barcelona) has replaced Hector Fort.
80' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
79' A pass into the penalty area from Jules Kounde (Barcelona) is intercepted by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
77' The referee signals a substitution. Oriol Romeu is brought on as a substitute for Sergi Roberto (Barcelona).
77' That will be all from Joao Felix who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Vitor Roque (Barcelona).
76' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

76' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Atl. Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
74' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
73' Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Barcelona in a dangerous position.
72' The attendance for today's match is 68253.
72' A shot from the edge of the box by Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) is close, but lifts narrowly over the bar at the last second.
71' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
66' Substitution. Rodrigo de Paul walks off the pitch and Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) comes on as a substitute.

65' 0 - 3 A perfect lofted pass from Robert Lewandowski finds Fermin Lopez (Barcelona), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header into the left side of the goal. His effort was both strong and precise, and Jan Oblak had no chance of stopping that. 0:3.
64' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside. The offside statistics – 8:0.
63' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) is desperate to score a goal, but he misses the target after striking the ball well wide of the left post.
61' Stefan Savic (Atl. Madrid) can count himself lucky for not being sent off after only receiving a caution from the referee.
60' A substitution has been made. Raphinha goes off and Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) comes on.
60' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) dummies a defender then lets fly from the edge of the box, but the ball misses the left post by a mile.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marcos Llorente departs the field of play to be replaced by Koke (Atl. Madrid).
58' Diego Simeone prepares a substitution. Rodrigo Riquelme is replaced by Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid).
58' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) is caught offside yet again.
56' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) sends the corner into the box, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen intercepts it and averts the threat.
53' Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
53' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the bottom left corner, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen keeps it out with an amazing save.
53' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

52' A snap shot by Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) from the edge of the area flies towards the left side of the goal, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen produces a good save to thwart him. The referee blows his whistle, Atl. Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
51' Fermin Lopez tees up Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) with a precision cross. He holds off the defender, but fires his shot just wide of the left post.
47' 0 - 2 Raphinha plays a neat ball into the path of Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona), who makes room for a shot and sends in a low drive which bounces in off the left post! 0:2.
46' Jose Sanchez shows a yellow card to Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) for his blatant foul. Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) comes off for Memphis Depay.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Diego Simeone probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid). He is replaced by Antoine Griezmann.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker over the bar.
42' Confusion on the bench but it seems Xavi has received a second yellow card from the ref and is walking off!

42' The flag is raised by the referee's assistant. Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) is repeatedly being caught offside. He's always hanging on the shoulder of the last man to try and get into a scoring position.
41' Referee Jose Sanchez halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Xavi, then shows him a yellow.
40' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.
38' 0 - 1 Goal! Robert Lewandowski tees up Joao Felix (Barcelona) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom right corner. 0:1.
38' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and releases a quick shot to the bottom left corner. His promising effort is kept out by Jan Oblak, who pulls off a stunning save!
35' Robert Lewandowski delivers a perfect cross for Raphinha (Barcelona), who has simple job scoring from close range but somehow contrives to send the ball just wide of the right post.

34' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass. Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) sends a long ball forward to Reinildo Mandava, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.
33' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
33' 3:0 – the total goal attempt statistics.
30' The resulting corner from Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) comes to nothing.

30' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The ball is out of play. Barcelona will have a chance to score from a corner.
27' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
26' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
23' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
23' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner with a short pass.
21' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) but poses no threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
19' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

19' A direct free kick from a promising position, taken by Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid), is struck into one of the defending players who deals with the threat. The linesman makes the right call and Atl. Madrid will have a corner.
18' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle and signals a foul after Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) brought his opponent down. Atl. Madrid have a free kick.
16' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) is flagged offside and it's not the first time today.
15' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
12' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
11' Raphinha (Barcelona) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Barcelona have a corner.
8' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) sends a long ball forward to Raphinha, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
7' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) gets a nice pass from Rodrigo de Paul on the edge of the box, he looks up and tries to beat the keeper in the corner but it goes just wide of the right post.
6' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
6' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
5' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner but it's cleared. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Atl. Madrid.
5' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Atl. Madrid.
2' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid), but the defence gets it clear.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Barcelona will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Jose Sanchez.
